mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that dampens corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has exceeded 4.5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by a labor market tightness (UNRATE below 4.0% and PAYEMS growth above 0.5% monthly), the risk of overheating and subsequent monetary tightening accelerates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansion periods despite the labor market tightness condition.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals a weakening in the real economy, leading to reduced corporate earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1,200,000 units for two consecutive months, it indicates a weakening in the residential sector, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST falls below 1,200,000 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL above 3.5% year-over-year), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.0% triggers a shift to restrictive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a rise in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 0.5% monthly growth signals a rapidly tightening labor market, which increases the risk of inflation and monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS growth above 0.5% fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.
